items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You mentioned a couple of them like Caducin and French.

ctx.x: Do you have any other favorite trombone players? You mentioned a couple of them like Caducin and French. Anybody else that you like in the old days? Some of the old timers if you can remember that we didn't hear maybe? Did you ever hear Carnage? How was he?
Whoa, Carnage? Well, he don't much. Wasn't anything special? No. Make a whole lot of noise.
